summary: One action inside violet-menu, with optional leading and trailing content.

usage.text: It fires an invoke event, with no detail, on click, Enter or Space. It has no value attribute: identify the item by event.target, an id or a data-* attribute.
A disabled item stays focusable and reachable with the arrow keys but does not fire the invoke event.

a11y.text: Type-ahead matches the item's whole text content, including text in the before and after slots.
